messages.subject: Calculate density with few cameras
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to calculate density of different populations of one species but in one of the sites where the camera trapping was carried out, only four cameras captured organisms of the species and there is only one recapture, i.e. only one individual was captured in two cameras on different days. Considering the photos of the all the cameras, only 3 individuals were identified.

Is it possible to calculate density using secr with just this data?



Alejandra

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Calculate density with few cameras
parts:
Hi Alejandra
If you can assume that the detection model from other populations also applies to this one then you can at least go through the motions of making an estimate by sharing information across populations (sessions). You could use a multi-session model with constant g0 and sigma across sessions (g0~1, sigma~1, the default); either set D~session or use CL = TRUE and then derived() to infer session-specific densities.

I don't mean to imply that these estimates, which will have crazy wide confidence intervals, will be very meaningful in themselves, but, if the assumption is stated up front, perhaps it's better to include them in the suite of estimates than to hide them and skew the results.
Murray
